title: Flock is out, but Santa Barbara City Council tables implementing Verkada cameras
snippet: Dr. Giovanni Vigna, a distinguished professor of Computer Science at UC Santa Barbara who specializes in surveillance and vulnerability assessment research, told the News-Press that a camera is just a sensor that captures what it sees. 'A camera gets a picture, how you post process it has nothing to do with the camera,' Vigna said.
match_reason: websearch (press_quote) — The article quotes Dr. Giovanni Vigna, Distinguished Professor of Computer Science at UC Santa Barbara, discussing the security and privacy implications of AI-powered surveillance cameras.
